text: This keyboard—actually, no, this app—is so accurate, it surprises me. It knows when I make a mistake and it knows how to format without being told. For example: 1. It doesn't lose track with long texts. 2. It stays on when I pause too long 3. It even paraphrases how I talk 4. It numbered this without being told 5. I made a mistake in this review, but it picked up on my mistake and corrected it. It's like someone is living inside this app and it knew I was talking about it lol
